attributes.board_name: Alabama Board of Examiners for Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology (ABESPA)

rules.accepted_credit_types: ASHA- or AAA-approved workshops; academic coursework at a regionally accredited college (3 semester hours = 12 hours); ABESPA-approved distance learning/self-study and university, school, clinic, hospital or state agency in-services; peer-reviewed articles (max 2 hours); first-time presentations at 1.5x; college teaching not accepted. 1 hour = 1 clock hour.
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal is prorated: 1 clock hour of CE for every month licensed in Alabama.
rules.audit_note: 10% of licensees randomly audited each year; late renewal triggers an automatic audit. Keep documentation 5 years.

topics.who: One of the 10 Content Area I hours should be in ethics (2 of 24 for dual licensees)

rules.notes: Calendar-year cycle (Jan 1–Dec 31), renewal by Dec 31. At least 10 of the 12 hours in the area of licensure (Content Area I), max 2 in related areas (Content Area II). Dual SLP + audiology licensees need 24 hours, split equally, at least 10 per discipline from Content Area I; one activity cannot count for both. Same rule for SLPs and audiologists.

rules.accepted_credit_types: CE related to the activities the assistant is registered to perform; Board-approved academic coursework.
rules.audit_note: Evidence of the 10 hours is submitted with the annual registration renewal together with the supervisor's written renewal request.
rules.notes: Alabama registers (does not license) SLP/audiology assistants; registrations expire Dec 31 each year. Rule amended effective Aug 14, 2026 (CE requirement unchanged).
